Our client is an international environmental services company dedicated to protecting the planet with sustainable mobile filtration solutions for liquids and gases.

They have approximately 450 employees, united as Generation D., all committed to driving positive ecological change across various industries.

Jobomschrijving

What does a Process Operator ?

Quality responsibility – You ensure the optimal production of high-quality reactivated carbon by precisely adjusting process parameters to maintain excellent production output.

Operational responsibility – You start up, operate, monitor, and shut down various technical installations to ensure uninterrupted production.

Problem-solving – When technical malfunctions occur, you analyze the cause and perform necessary repairs or adjustments to maintain production efficiency.

Process optimization – You actively contribute ideas for improvements to enhance efficiency and sustainability in production processes.

Forklift operation – You will use a forklift for various tasks, ensuring a smooth and safe production process.

Why You?

Are you ready to work in a dynamic and innovative environment where you can continuously contribute to improvements? Then you might be the perfect candidate!

 

Your Team as a Process Operator

You will join a fantastic team of technical operators and forklift drivers in Rumbeke, reporting directly to your team lead.

Who Are We Looking For?
	
• A strong technical background (mechanics, electricity, etc.) and a passion for technology and innovation.	
• Fluent in English and/or Dutch.	
• Forklift certification required.	
• Analytical and problem-solving skills – You can quickly detect and resolve technical issues.	
• Hands-on mentality – You are proactive and not afraid to get your hands dirty.	
• Team player – You can work well in a team but are also capable of working independently.	
• Flexibility – Willing to work in a shift system.	
• Safety-conscious – You always prioritize safety and strictly follow procedures.	
• Even if you don’t meet all the criteria but strongly identify with our core values – Teamwork, Excellence, and Devotion – we encourage you to apply!

•

•  	
• The ability to work independently.	
•  	
• The motivation to continuously learn through our training programs.	
•  	
• You speak good Dutch or good English.

Are you ready to start your career as a Maintenance Technician in a dynamic and technology-driven environment? As a Maintenance Technician, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring the optimal performance of our client's advanced machinery.

On an average day, you'll troubleshoot machine malfunctions, perform preventive maintenance, and collaborate with machine setters and operators to enhance production processes. Your proactive efforts will contribute to improvements in quality, output, and safety.

If you're eager to embark on a fulfilling career, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable part of our team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

• Technical school degree

• Good level of English

• Flexibility, motivation, and a strong sense of responsibility

• Experience in pneumatics and hydraulics is a plus

• Problem-solving mindset

• Willingness to work shifts

About the Role
Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.
Key Responsibilities
• Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq.
• Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design.
• Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency.
• Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team.
Requirements & Qualifications
• Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects.
• Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts.
• Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory).
• Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects.
• Language Skills:
• Fluent English (written and spoken).
• Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration).
• Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams.

About this job
For a foodcompany in Meulebeke, we are looking for a line supervisor for a 2-shift schedule.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action

What will your responsibilities be?

• You’ll thoroughly troubleshoot and resolve malfunctions in machines and systems.

Who are you?

• You have a technical mindset! This is reflected in your experience or technical training.

Founded in 1948, our client is a Belgian family-owned company specializing in exterior joinery. The group operates several production sites manufacturing aluminium, PVC and wooden windows, doors, garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems. The company is known for its modern production facilities, continuous innovation and long-term investment in employee development.

Jobomschrijving

If you are passionate about technology, eager to learn, and looking to build your career in a modern manufacturing environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Our client is looking for Junior Maintenance Technicians / Electromechanics who have a technical education and are motivated to develop their skills through comprehensive on-the-job training.

Without reliable maintenance, there is no quality! As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the smooth operation of production by performing preventive maintenance, identifying technical issues, and supporting continuous improvements.

During approximately the first year, you will work in a two-shift system (early and late shifts) while completing your training. After your training period, you must be willing to work night shifts as part of the regular production schedule.

We are primarily looking for candidates who:
	
• Have a technical education in Electromechanics, or a related technical field (Bachelor's degree, Associate degree, technical secondary education, or equivalent).	
• Have a basic understanding of mechatronics, including fundamentals of PLC systems, sensors, actuators, electricity, mechanics and pneumatics.	
• Are motivated to learn and develop through practical training in the workplace.	
• Have a hands-on mentality and enjoy solving technical problems.	
• Work accurately and pay attention to safety.	
• Enjoy working in a team and communicate well with colleagues.	
• Have a communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Jobomschrijving

 Key Responsibilities

Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. Renowned for its collaborative culture, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to talent development, the company offers an excellent environment for young professionals looking to launch their career in Supply Chain.

To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Engineering, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning
• Strong analytical mindset with good problem-solving abilities
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
• Comfortable working with data and supply chain KPIs
• Eager to learn and develop within an international environment
• Organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders
• Team player with a positive and hands-on attitude

Our client is an innovative manufacturing company seeking an experienced engineering professional to strengthen its operations and accelerate continuous improvement projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and execute manufacturing improvement and process optimization projects while managing multiple priorities.

• Provide technical expertise to production, quality, maintenance, and commercial teams, including support for quality issues and new product feasibility assessments.

• Proven experience in a manufacturing or production environment with expertise in project management, process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a hands-on mindset and the ability to prioritize and deliver quick results.
• Good knowledge of SolidWorks and experience working with industrial machinery and manufacturing processes.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills; additional languages are considered an asset.

CE Driver Wanted in the Port of Antwerp

For a logistics company located in the Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced and motivated CE Driver.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transport of bulk goods and containers to and from various locations in and around the port. You will join a professional transport environment where safety, punctuality and clear communication are key.

What will you do?

• You are responsible for container transport to and from the Port of Antwerp.
• You collect containers from terminals and deliver them to customers.
• You carry out national transport, mainly within Belgium and the surrounding region.
• You check the load and ensure that containers are properly and safely secured.
• You ensure the correct handling of transport documents.
• You stay in contact with the planning department and communicate any problems or delays.
• You comply with the applicable safety regulations in the port.
• You are responsible for the proper inspection and care of your truck and trailer.

You will mainly work from the Port of Antwerp and carry out predominantly national and regional routes.

Interested?

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

REF: MEC1

• You have a valid CE driving licence and Code 95
• Previous experience with container transport is preferred.
• Experience driving in the Port of Antwerp is a strong advantage.
• An  ADR certificate is a strong advantage.
• You are a safe and responsible driver.
• You are punctual, reliable and customer-oriented.
• You can work independently, while communicating smoothly with the planning department.
• You are flexible and have no problem with the dynamic nature of port and transport work.
• You have a sufficient level of  English to communicate smoothly.
